warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>,C1' -- footing mark + the column C1 standing on it. C1 is recorded once, in the S-02 structure-plan file (same 14 points).

The plan draws no grid lines through the body, only the bubbles and the dimension chains; each footing was placed by the position of its column square against the printed chains (all 14 land on a printed line within a few mm at 1:75).
G1'' (x = 1.00) is the 1.00 + 2.10 tick of the third x chain -- a printed position, not a guess. A'6 and B'6' sit on the printed bubbles A' and 6'.
Pile caps are rectangular for F1 (0.75 x 1.20) and F3 (1.20 x 1.65) on S-05; their drawn orientation differs by position (see each note). F2 (1.20 square) and F4 (1.65 square) are square.
